summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Calamos S&P 500 Structured Alt Protection ETF - October (CPSO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in downside hedge alternatives. The fund seeks to track the return of the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY), to a cap, with 100% downside hedge over a one-year outcome period. The actively managed fund holds FLEX options to obtain exposure CPSO was launched on Oct 1, 2024 and is issued by Calamos.
